4131-4659-5660-6769.easyPrerequisites: Evolution Witness has a +1/+1 counter on it.

Cast Basalt Monolith by paying its mana cost.
When Basalt Monolith enters, Surge Conductor triggers.
Holding priority, activate Basalt Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Basalt Monolith, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Surge Conductor trigger, causing you to proliferate, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evolution Witness.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning Basalt Monolith from your graveyard to your hand.

You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.

Activate Loot by sacrificing the land
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Emeria Angel triggers, creating a 1/1 white Bird creature token with flying
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.

Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Conspiracy, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
4247-4875-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1619-4050-4605-5542-6135.notablePrerequisites: You are able to complete a dungeon.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6135.description:
Complete a dungeon.
Sefris' second ability triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the first trigger, returning up to one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the second trigger, returning Aarakocra Sneak from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
When Aarakocra Sneak enters, it and Preston trigger twice due to Delney.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Aarakocra Sneak.
Resolve a Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Aarakocra Sneak token enters, it triggers twice due to Delney.
Resolve the Aarakocra Sneak token triggers, venturing into Undercity twice.
Resolve the second Preston trigger from step 5, creating a token copy of Aarakocra Sneak that is a 0/1 Illusion.
Repeat steps 8 and 9 one additional time.
Resolve the first Aarakocra Sneak trigger from step 5, venturing into Undercity and completing Undercity.
Repeat from step 2.
1619-4050-4605-5542-6135.notes: You can choose whatever path you desire while venturing through Undercity.

Repeat using the Morgue Toad token

Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Megatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Megatog ability.
Repeat.

Resolve both Deserted Temple abilities, untapping Deserted Temple and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx
Repeat

Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Repeat.

When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.

Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

The damage is prevented due to Phyrexian Vindicator's replacement effect. Phyrexian Vindicator triggers, dealing 2 damage to you.

Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

Resolve the Kodama trigger from step 7, putting the land returned to your hand onto the battlefield.

Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Scholar of the Ages from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

 Activate Together Forever by paying {1}, making it so the next time Kobolds of Kher Keep dies this turn, it returns to your hand.
